text: 中国财政部发行91天期债券，规模600亿元，发行利率1.1222%，边际利率1.1666%，预期1.1100%，投标倍数2.86倍，边际倍数5.86倍； 中国财政部发行7年期债券，规模1200亿元，发行利率1.4241%，边际利率1.4425%，预期1.4300%，投标倍数3.63倍，边际倍数4.44倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 91-day bonds with a scale of RMB 60 billion, an issuance rate of 1.1222%, a marginal rate of 1.1666%, against an expected 1.1100%, with a bid-to-cover ratio of 2.86 times and a marginal ratio of 5.86 times; China's Ministry of Finance issued 7-year bonds with a scale of RMB 120 billion, an issuance rate of 1.4241%, a marginal rate of 1.4425%, against an expected 1.4300%, with a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.63 times and a marginal ratio of 4.44 times.
